newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Southeast in T$2 bln shipyard deal.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Southeast in T$2 bln shipyard deal.

text.p: Taiwan Southeast Cement will buy a state-owned shipyard at Taiwan's southern port of Kaohsiung for T$2.27 billion, a company spokesman said on Friday.
"We likely will sign the contract to buy the shipyard from Taiwan Machinery by the end of the year," Huang Chi-hsiang told Reuters by telephone.
Huang declined to give further details.
Taiwan Machinery, owned by the economics ministry, was delisted from the Taiwan Stock Exchange on February 28 after its cumulative losses rose to T$11.6 billion on June 30, 1995.
The economics ministry has decided to sell off Taiwan Machinery's principal operations -- its steel, shipping, alloy steel and heavy machinery facilities.
Taiwan's Ton Yi Industrial Corp in 1996 invested T$4.8 billion to merge with Taiwan Machinery's steel plant.
